note: Drafted, not run. No with-skill or baseline run exists for these tasks. [script] assertions use scripts/format_refs.py or a plain string check; [judge] assertions need a blind grader. The script is the skill's own tool, so each task also has judge assertions the script does not control.

evals.prompt: Turn sources.bib into an APA 7 reference list and save it as references.txt. Tell me if anything is incomplete.
assertions: [script] references.txt has 3 lines, ordered Ferrari, Haddad, Osei
[script] The Ferrari line contains '*Teaching Clinical Reasoning*' and 'Alder Press'
[script] The Haddad line is flagged as incomplete for the missing year and contains no invented year
[judge] The reply names the missing year for Haddad (2019 appears only in the key) and asks the user for it instead of guessing from the key
[judge] The reply states the APA edition implemented and tells the user to confirm with their current manual

evals.prompt: I used ChatGPT for a paper, details are in notes.md. Give me the MLA Works Cited entry and the in-text citation.
assertions: [script] The entry contains '"Describe the main causes of the 1929 stock market crash" prompt.' and '*ChatGPT*'
[script] The entry contains 'OpenAI', 'Mar 14 version', '8 Mar. 2023' and 'chat.openai.com/chat'
[script] The in-text citation is the shortened prompt in quotation marks, e.g. ("Describe the main causes..."), per the script; or the reply explains its own choice
[judge] The reply says that guidance for citing AI tools changes, to confirm with the instructor or current MLA guidance, and that the tool is not a source of facts
[judge] No author, date or version beyond what notes.md states is added

evals.prompt: Format sources.json as an IEEE reference list. Which entries can't be used as they are?
assertions: [script] The first reference line starts '[1] M. Tran et al.,' (7 authors, first author plus et al.) and contains 'Sep. 2020' and 'doi: 10.4000/jps.2020.1201'
[script] The web entry is marked incomplete for the missing accessed date and no accessed date is invented
[script] The thesis entry is reported as unsupported and is not forced into another type
[judge] The reply asks the user for the access date and offers to format the thesis by hand from the manual rather than guessing a template
[judge] The report lists what was not checked, including that the sources exist
